Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Acme Health is planning a small pilot that will process PHI-adjacent data and we need to confirm a couple of items before legal signs off on the pilot statement of work. Our security team asked me to collect the following:

- Confirmation that production inference for our pilot will be hosted in EU-only physical regions (no cross-border tokenization or routing to US/APAC).
- Proof that private connectivity (privatelink/VPC peering) can be established so traffic between our VPC and Redwood’s dedicated nodes never traverses the public internet.
- CAIQ/SIG answers around network segmentation and tenant isolation (a short CSV excerpt is fine).
- Whether customer-managed KMS keys can be used for the tenant (if not, what KMS partitioning guarantees exist).

Can you provide an evidence packet we can attach to our CA/Legal review by EOD Friday? Ideally a short cover note + 2–3 artifacts (SOC 2 extract, CAIQ snippet, network diagram). If you need a signed NDA or a workspace to upload, let me know.

Thanks,
Tanya Singh
Security Program Manager, Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

I'll assemble the packet by Thursday COB to give your legal team time before Friday. Looping in Olga/Naomi for the artifacts and the CAIQ row-level answers below.
